kind: independent source reconciliation before Android remediation
verdict: All five reported source findings confirmed with bounded qualifications; no proposed controls executed and no remedy approval.

findings.disposition: confirmed source defect; no device measurement
findings.trace: require_emulator or require_snapshot raises before any force-stop/start acquisition. __enter__ always invokes __exit__, whose first action force-stops the selected package. Existing refusal controls210-265 exclude clear/kill/start but omit force-stop. No pm clear after refusal is established.
findings.regression: Separate physical and cold-boot negatives using the actual session entry and independently recorded command state; allow only getprop, require exact refusal object and no destructive/cleanup action before backup. Preserve opt-in and healthy command-order positives.
findings.repair_boundary: Track actual authorized launch ownership only after validation; refusal must not acquire cleanup authority.

findings.disposition: confirmed source defect; no remote-file leak measurement
findings.contract: A configuration file acquired by a successful push must remain owned through later chmod/setup failure.
findings.trace: Actual push_text performs successful push then exits local temporary directory and executes chmod. _start sets configured only after push_text returns. Either later failure can bypass configured cleanup, and the wrapper stores the session only after successful entry.
findings.regression: Delegate actual push_text through a bounded offline adb boundary that retains a separate file witness on successful push, then raise the original chmod fault. Observe file removal and original error before independent backup. This is offline remote-command state, not a real-device residue claim.
findings.repair_boundary: Acquire concrete configuration cleanup ownership before the fallible post-push phase, after refusal guards; preserve healthy command ordering and explicitly handle pre-existing configuration ownership.

findings.disposition: confirmed source defect with existing outer body-primary retention
findings.contract: Every acquired reverse/config/browser cleanup must be attempted; independent failures and initiating errors must remain reachable.
findings.trace: First force-stop/reverse/remove failure escapes and skips later operations. check=False ignores command exit status but not subprocess TimeoutExpired/OSError or interruption. On failed entry __exit__ can replace the initiating raised object, although implicit context may retain it. Direct AndroidSession body details are ignored. LaunchedBrowser453-461 already combines its body primary with escaping session cleanup; it cannot recover skipped actions or failed-entry primary classification.
findings.regression: Acquire real canonical offline session state, inject exact failures after individual cleanup command boundaries, and independently require all later actions plus ordered original objects. Include no-primary, entry-primary, direct body-primary, existing LaunchedBrowser body-primary and control-flow interruption. Snapshot before backup and distinguish process/command witnesses from device results.
findings.repair_boundary: Concrete all-action cleanup collection and explicit entry composition. Preserve existing browser failure policy; do not introduce a circular Android-to-browser dependency or generic owner framework.

findings.disposition: confirmed direct-constructor input defect; ordinary CLI uses valid default
findings.contract: A successful launch must perform at least one actual open attempt.
findings.trace: typing_attempts=0 or negative passes __post_init__; range is empty after destructive configuration/reverses and _start returns success without _open even for intent entry. LaunchedBrowser constructor preserves default3; no CLI attempt override was found.
findings.regression: Independent zero/negative constructor rejection before commands, plus positive one-attempt actual canonical intent dispatch. Keep existing zero settle/delay and zero typing_timeout controls valid.
findings.repair_boundary: Validate positive attempt count at immutable launch input boundary; no new global timing policy.

findings.disposition: confirmed blocking caller path; deadlock/corruption and measured timing remain unestablished
findings.contract: Async browser launch must allow the same event loop to serve and deliver cancellation.
findings.trace: Android plans never take turns. enter_browser directly runs synchronous __enter__, which executes subprocess.run and time.sleep. BrowserDriver.__aexit__ synchronously runs Android cleanup too. Snapshot has Android choices and starts TCP/QUIC serving before entering BrowserDriver on that loop; its own run timeout starts only after entry. Direct android_run is intentionally synchronous.
findings.regression: Use a real finite adb stand-in child with independent readiness and external gate/backup, then require loop callback or actual loopback response while canonical entry is held. Separately cancel and require eventual ownership cleanup/worker error observation. Use an independent watchdog because the loop under test cannot deliver its own timer during synchronous blocking.
findings.repair_boundary: Concrete owned worker for Android entry and cleanup with cancellation association and eventual result observation; a bare detached to_thread conversion is insufficient.

standards: Keep touched independent validation/acquisition/cleanup stages in separate readable paragraphs; preserve current command sequence and small owner boundaries. No unrelated documentation rewrite or timing/environment policy is justified.
retained_candidates: CLI hold finite/nonnegative policy is unspecified; no new rule imposed.
--allow-cold-boot mutates process environment even for print-only invocation, but no repeated in-process caller was verified; keep separate candidate.
Preference newline/name encoding and shell extreme/leading-zero ports have no established reachable failure; no parser/native execution.
Remote completion after adb timeout remains ambiguous and separate from the concrete successful-push/post-push gap.
limits: No target imports, runtime/native/device/network execution or checkers; all evidence is source-only.
Whole coverage granted only six owners,576-line test owner and explicitly full policy files; browser_launch and snapshot remain partial.
No emulator version/build/property authenticity, snapshot/GPU behavior, boot timing or real-browser parity verified.
Host subprocess timeout and direct-child cleanup source do not promise remote action rollback, descendant termination or total session deadline.
Current integration contains central metadata edits; review uses frozen854 Git objects, not dirty metadata content.
Root owns controls, implementation authorization, CHANGELOG/ledger and both-host native verification.
operations: read-only Git/file reads and discovery searches
